title: Asking & Reacting: 怎么样, 怎么 (why), 啊, 吧 (fine…)
description: How is it / how about, 'how come?', the exclamation 啊, and the reluctant 好吧.

points.title: …怎么样?: how is it? / how about?
points.summary: 怎么样 at the end asks for an opinion, or makes a suggestion: '…, how about it?'.
points.body:
- 这个菜**怎么样**?
- 我们明天去公园，**怎么样**?
examples: What do you think of this dish?

points.title: 怎么 + verb?: how come?
points.summary: 怎么 before a verb (especially with 不/没) asks 'how come?', with surprise.
points.body: - 你**怎么**没来上课? (How come you didn't come to class?)
examples: How come you didn't come to class?

points.title: …啊!: exclamation, warmth
points.summary: 啊 (a) at the end adds feeling: surprise, enthusiasm, reproach.
points.body:
- 去**啊**! 当然去!
- 你怎么不早说**啊**!
examples: Why didn't you say so earlier!

points.title: 好吧: OK, fine (conceding)
points.summary: 吧 can concede: 好吧 = 'OK then' (often a little reluctant).
points.body: - A: 八十块，可以吗? B: **好吧**.

notes: 怎么 needs a verb after it.
questions.translation: What do you think of this dish? — It's delicious.

notes: 怎么 can't end a suggestion.
哪儿 = 'where' — the place is already given.
questions.translation: Let's go to the park tomorrow — how about it?

notes: 怎么样 can't go before a verb like this.
questions.translation: How come you didn't come to class yesterday? Were you ill?

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{怎么|zěnme}{不|bù}{说话|shuōhuà}？」 mean?
notes: 怎么 + 不 asks 'why not', not 'in what way'.
吧 would make it a suggestion.
questions.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier!

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}？
B：{去|qù}（　）！{当然|dāngrán}{去|qù}！
notes: 怎么样 asks for an opinion — B is answering.
呢 doesn't fit an enthusiastic answer.
questions.translation: A: Are you going? B: Of course I am!

questions.prompt: Said with a sigh, what does 「{好|hǎo}{吧|ba}。」 mean?

A：{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yīfu}{一百|yìbǎi}{块|kuài}。
B：{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}，{八十|bāshí}{块|kuài}，{可以|kěyǐ}{吗|ma}？
A：（　），{八十|bāshí}{就|jiù}{八十|bāshí}。
notes: 好吗 asks — but A is agreeing.
questions.translation: A: This is 100 yuan. B: Too expensive — 80, OK? A: Fine, 80 it is.
